- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger and Instagram), so you can write or call me there. Each one needs a *separate account with its own phone number*, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like me to set any of these up?
